general2.event: You see r_c:0 leading a patrol around the borders. They, along with r_c:1 and r_c:2, snarl and chase you away after spotting you hanging around.

general3.event: Life outside of the borders of your home is harder than you imagined. You miss the company of others within the camp, the comradery of your Clanmates.

general4.event: Prey is harder to come by out here. You take the time to sneak into c_n territory as carefully as you can, but get caught by r_c:0 and chased away again.

general5.event: You meet a loner as you wander around. They seem wary of you however, and soon moves on.

general6.event: You meet a small group of rogues you know have been causing problems for your former Clan. With a bit of well-timed mischief, you manage to chase them off without a hitch.

general7.event: One day you notice a kit wandering just outside of the territory looking lost. Oh - that's r_c:0. You don't know how {PRONOUN/r_c:0/subject} go there but you watch over them until a patrol of frantic warriors comes to collect them.

general8.event: While lingering on the border you notice r_c:0 alone. You also notice a rogue stalking closer. You yowl a warning, and r_c:0 puffs up in shock before turning tail and racing back the way {PRONOUN/r_c:0/subject} came.

general9.event: You notice a flourishing patch of herbs. c_n would find this useful... You end up deciding to leave some on a path you know r_c:0 takes daily.

general10.event: A group of rogues approach you to learn more about c_n. You sense they're up to no good. You share a bit of information anyways, and wish them luck with whatever they're planning.

general11.event: You watch the daily life of your former Clan with growing resentment...

general12.event: You catch a mouse right before it crosses the border.

general13.event: A bird escapes from r_c:0 - and right into your awaiting paws. You sneer your gratitude as r_c:0 hisses and spits in fury.

general14.event: You spot a patrol meandering along the border chatting idly.

general15.event: As you walk along the border, a voice calls out to you. It's r_c:0, reminding you to stay out. You continue on without a care in the world.

assertive16.event: You spend some time within c_n's borders. Sure, you don't need to anymore, but it's fun to spite your former Clan.

assertive17.event: Despite exile being a punishment, it isn't for you. You've never felt so free. Now you can do what you want - without your Clanmates breathing down your neck.

assertive18.event: Some rogues are causing trouble for c_n. Without hesitation you chase them off. c_n is yours to mess with - not theirs.

assertive19.event: r_c:0 is stalking a bird. You take a second before deciding to have some fun. You yowl to scare both r_c:0 and the bird. It takes off in a burst of panic, and your former Clanmate spits at you.

assertive20.event: While sneaking around on c_n territory, you notice a patch of herbs flourishing. Just for the sake of it you trample part of the plant before leaving. r_c:0 will be spitting mad later!

assertive21.event: When you meet a passing loner, they strike up conversation. You hold nothing back about your past in c_n, however, and the loner is quick to make an excuse to leave.

assertive22.event: You meet with a rogue you know is pleasant to work with. With your information, they are able to put together some plans to make c_n regret exiling you.

assertive23.event: Exile is anything but boring. You can always bother your former Clanmates - or accomplish your dreams of exploring freely.

assertive24.event: You mark your scent on the c_n borders. You're still here. They'd do well to remember that.

introspective25.event: Being exiled has its perks - you're now able to daydream and wonder out loud without complaining cats disrupting your very critical alone time... at least.

introspective26.event: You're starting to wonder if you're hearing voices within the unfamiliar silence, but despite your efforts to search the surroundings - nothing. Is it all in your head?

rare27.event: Your hunting brings you right to the border, and your prey escapes over the scentlines. You curse your luck before r_c:0 shows themselves with your lost meal. {PRONOUN/r_c:0/subject/CAP} stare at you a moment before dropping {PRONOUN/r_c:0/poss} catch and walking away to let you take it.

rare28.event: To your surprise, r_c:0 approaches you one moon with a bundle of herbs, placing them a distance away. No words were exchanged, but as r_c:0 treads back to the clan, you can't help but wonder if this act of kindness was pity - or something else entirely?
